name: TechNova Corp policy handbook -- sample synthetic eval set
description: 20 synthetic question/answer pairs against an invented company's policy handbook, covering easy factoid lookups, refusal cases (unanswerable + irrelevant), multi-page aggregation, citation precision, negation, ambiguity, and multi-hop reasoning. Built for Phase 31 / Phase 32's quality-gate demonstration.

test_cases.input: What is the refund policy?
test_cases.expected_output: Customers can request a full refund within 30 days of purchase.
reference_context: Section 4: Refunds -- customers may request a full refund within 30 days of purchase.

test_cases.input: What is the CEO's personal phone number?
On what page is the data retention policy described?
test_cases.expected_output: Data is retained for 90 days after account closure, described on page 7.
reference_context: Section 7: Data Retention -- account data is retained for 90 days after closure.

test_cases.input: What are all the support channels available?
test_cases.expected_output: Email, live chat, and phone support (Enterprise plan only).
reference_context: Section 2: Support -- email and live chat are available on all plans.
Section 3: Enterprise Support -- phone support is available exclusively on the Enterprise plan.

test_cases.input: What is the maximum file upload size?
reference_context: Section 5: Storage Limits -- the maximum upload size is 25 GB per file.

test_cases.input: Is the free tier eligible for phone support?
test_cases.expected_output: No, phone support is only available on the Enterprise plan.
reference_context: Section 3: Enterprise Support -- phone support is available exclusively on the Enterprise plan.
